House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for replacement of park buildings and facilities in Dakota County regional parks; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+DAKOTA COUNTY REGIONAL PARKS; UPDATED BUILDINGS AND FACILITIES. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+$22,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Dakota County to design, construct, furnish, and equip the replacement of structurally degraded, unsafe, and undersized buildings, facilities, and infrastructure at Dakota County regional parks. This appropriation includes money for replacement of the swimming beach facility at Lebanon Hills Regional Park, including fully accessible restrooms and showers, all-terrain wheelchair and watercraft storage, and energy efficient electrical/mechanical systems. Improvements also include a swimming beach facility patio, trails, an outdoor open area for concessions and other amenities, and infrastructure at Schulze Lake Beach. This appropriation also includes money for campground improvements at both Lebanon Hills Regional Park and Lake Byllesby Regional Park, including updated campground lodge and office facilities with storm shelter areas, fully accessible restroom and shower buildings for campers, trails, and other campground facilities and infrastructure. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $22,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for replacement of park buildings and facilities in Dakota County regional parks; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. DAKOTA COUNTY REGIONAL PARKS; UPDATED BUILDINGS AND FACILITIES.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$22,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Dakota County to design, construct, furnish, and equip the replacement of structurally degraded, unsafe, and undersized buildings, facilities, and infrastructure at Dakota County regional parks. This appropriation includes money for replacement of the swimming beach facility at Lebanon Hills Regional Park, including fully accessible restrooms and showers, all-terrain wheelchair and watercraft storage, and energy efficient electrical/mechanical systems. Improvements also include a swimming beach facility patio, trails, an outdoor open area for concessions and other amenities, and infrastructure at Schulze Lake Beach. This appropriation also includes money for campground improvements at both Lebanon Hills Regional Park and Lake Byllesby Regional Park, including updated campground lodge and office facilities with storm shelter areas, fully accessible restroom and shower buildings for campers, trails, and other campground facilities and infrastructure.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $22,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
